title: Pulsed laser deposition of delafossite oxide thin films on YSZ (001) substrates as solar water splitting photocathodes
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00706A, Paper
Chenyu Zhou, Atiya Banerjee, Esteban Luis Fornero, Zhaoyi Xi, Xiao Tong, Eli Stavitski, Xiaohui Qu, Sara E. Mason, Dario J. Stacchiola, Mingzhao Liu
Delafossite-phase CuAlO2 and CuFeO2 thin film photocathodes were developed for solar water splitting, with CuFeO2 showing higher efficiency due to improved light absorption.
